title: leucanthemum vulgare var. ageratifolium
intro: Leucanthemum vulgare var. ageratifolium, commonly known as Oxeye Daisy, is a subspecies of the Oxeye Daisy plant, a flowering plant native to Europe. This plant is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic effects. The health benefits of Leucanthemum vulgare var. ageratifolium include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions of sedation, antispasmodic, and antiseptic properties.
